name: Wandering Storykeeper
theme: A traveling Nordic keeper of stories who crosses settlements collecting local histories, preserving forgotten names, guiding companions with remembered paths, and turning hard-won knowledge into practical support.
visualIdentity: Layered travel garments, teal embroidery, carved story staff, memory scroll satchel, bronze memory tokens, fur collar, weathered road cloak, and restrained amber rune-memory effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, travel-garment silhouette, teal embroidery patterns, staff carvings, satchel design, bronze token details, fur placement, and teal, brown, gray, bronze, and amber palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Roadside Chronicle
starterAbilities.description: Gather and apply knowledge from remembered journeys and local histories.

starterAbilities.name: Guiding Tale
starterAbilities.description: Share lessons learned from past travelers to aid companions.

starterAbilities.name: Names Remembered
starterAbilities.description: Recall the deeds of forgotten heroes to strengthen allies.
